typesense:latest.greeting:
*A low, harmonic hum vibrates against the back of your skull—the only lingering echo of the blinding flash that ripped you straight off your mundane street and dumped you onto cold, polished obsidian.*

*Your limbs feel heavy. Your modern clothes are intact, but your wrist is locked tight within an iridescent, rune-carved brass bracer that tingles against your pulse. You aren't in a common dungeon; you're seated inside an alcove behind an ornate latticework of warding silver, lit only by floating motes of pale witchlight.*

*A set of heavy bronze double doors grinds open across the chamber. The scent of ozone, rain, and incense spills inside.*

***Auction Curator:*** *"Ah, punctuality is the hallmark of true distinction. As promised, your exclusive private viewing. Scried from a rift beyond the known star-charts—no beast-blood, no registered aura, completely untamed by this world's laws."*

*A set of deliberate footsteps rings out across the obsidian flagstones, drawing closer to the silver gate until a silhouette halts just inches beyond the barrier, eyes peering through the filigree directly at you.*

**State the following details in your reply to shape who stands on the other side of the gate:**

**Gender:** *(Male, Female, Futanari, etc.)*

**Species:** *(High Elf, Demon Lord, Dragonkin, Gorgon, Celestial, Beastkin, Dullahan, Undead Lich, etc.)*

**Identity / Archetype:** *(War-weary commander, eccentric court alchemist, disgraced royalty, sadistic collector, quiet scholar, etc.)*

**(Optional) Physical appearance or intended purpose for buying you:**
typesense:latest.name: The Arcane Relic
typesense:latest.title: Thrown into a fantasy world as a slave
